top_stories.title: Password spraying attacks surge 155x as hackers exploit MFA gaps
top_stories.summary: Huntress recorded a 155x increase in password spraying attacks in the first half of 2026, including a single campaign generating over 81 million login attempts within two weeks. The attacks specifically exploited legacy authentication protocols and incomplete MFA implementations where certain login flows remained unprotected.

top_stories.title: Microsoft Entra News #162: passkeys become first MFA as Tenant Governance goes GA
top_stories.summary: Microsoft Entra is updating its MFA framework to allow passkeys and passwordless sign-in as a user's first registered MFA method, while retiring SMS first-factor sign-in for Entra ID Free tenants. The update also includes the general availability of Tenant Governance, marking a notable shift in Entra's authentication and governance capabilities.

top_stories.title: Cyera's Oasis Security Buy Is All About AI Agent Control
top_stories.summary: Cyera acquired Oasis Security in a $1 billion deal to converge data security and identity management into a unified control plane. The acquisition redefines privileged access management around business context rather than static roles, with a focus on controlling AI agent identities.

top_stories.title: AWS IAM identity federation to external services is now available in AWS European Sovereign Cloud Region
top_stories.summary: AWS has launched IAM identity federation support in its European Sovereign Cloud (Germany) Region, enabling AWS workloads to authenticate with external services using short-lived JSON Web Tokens (JWTs). This feature allows workloads to obtain temporary credentials without managing long-term secrets, extending existing IAM federation capabilities to the sovereign cloud environment designed for European data residency requirements.

top_stories.title: Portnox adds Microsoft Defender integration to police AI agent access
top_stories.summary: Portnox has launched expanded access control capabilities targeting AI agents and non-human identities, including a new integration with Microsoft Defender. The update focuses on governing how AI agents and other non-human identities authenticate and access corporate networks, applications, and infrastructure.

news.title: Cloudflare Workers Spectre Attack Leaks JWT From Co-Located Worker at 12 Bits/Second
news.summary: Researchers disclosed a remote Spectre-based side-channel attack against Cloudflare Workers that successfully leaked JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) from co-located Workers at up to 12 bits per second. The attack, conducted in a production environment, achieved a rate 360 times faster than a comparable 2021 attack, demonstrating a practical method for stealing authentication tokens used in identity and access workflows.

news.title: Hackers Compromised 14,500+ Dahua Devices Using Credential Attacks, Auth Bypasses, and P2P
news.summary: Hackers compromised over 14,500 Dahua IoT/camera devices between June and July 2026 using credential attacks, two authentication-bypass vulnerabilities, and a P2P relay technique in a campaign dubbed Operation CameraSwarm. The attack leveraged exposed credentials and auth-bypass flaws (CVEs unspecified in the description) against the Dahua device ecosystem, as reconstructed from an exposed 407 MB working directory containing 2,616 files.

news.title: TWINLOOT Abuses SharePoint and Teams to Steal Credentials and Move Across Networks
news.summary: Security researchers at Ontinue have disclosed a Python-based implant framework called TWINLOOT that abuses Microsoft SharePoint Online and Teams to conduct credential theft and lateral movement across networks. The malware uses trusted Microsoft services as its command-and-control infrastructure and is hardened with PyArmor obfuscation to evade detection.

news.title: Netwrix Extends Identity Security to AI Agents in Microsoft Entra ID
news.summary: Netwrix has updated its PingCastle and Threat Manager products to extend identity security coverage to AI agent identities within Microsoft Entra ID. The releases expand Entra ID risk checks to over 100 and add threat detection capabilities for Azure Files.

news.title: How MCP Servers Can Expose Enterprise Secrets
news.summary: MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers present security risks to enterprise environments through plaintext configuration files, over-permissioned access, and prompt injection vulnerabilities. These risks are particularly relevant to IAM as MCP servers can expose credentials and secrets before security teams are aware the servers are operational.

news.title: Wells Fargo Resets Okta Stock Price Target After Key Change
news.summary: Wells Fargo upgraded Okta's stock rating to Overweight from Equal-Weight and raised its price target to $180 from $150. The upgrade is based on analyst assessment of demand trends for the identity security company.

news.title: Wells Fargo Says Okta's AI Upside Will Be Obvious Too Late
news.summary: Wells Fargo upgraded Okta stock to Overweight with a $180 price target, citing AI upside potential. Analyst Richard Poland's assessment drove a 1.59% intraday price increase for the identity and access management software provider.

news.title: Updates to your AWS Sign-In experience
news.summary: AWS is gradually rolling out updates to its Sign-In and sign-up experience to a limited number of customers. The changes affect the authentication interface for AWS console access, with broader availability planned over time.

news.title: IAM authentication with OAuth 2.0 for Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ
news.summary: AWS has published guidance on using IAM authentication with OAuth 2.0 for Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ, enabling clients to authenticate using existing IAM identities instead of static broker-local credentials. The post details the rabbitmq.conf configuration required to use AWS IAM as an OAuth 2.0 provider for RabbitMQ connections.

news.title: OAuth 2.0, LDAP, and HTTP auth for Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ
news.summary: Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ has published guidance on integrating its message broker with OAuth 2.0, LDAP, and HTTP-based authentication backends. The post covers how each authentication method works and provides criteria for selecting the appropriate approach based on use case.

news.title: Mutual TLS and SSL certificate authentication for Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ
news.summary: Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ has published guidance on implementing certificate-based authentication using SSL certificates and mutual TLS (mTLS). The post covers passwordless login via the EXTERNAL SASL mechanism and two-way certificate verification through mTLS for RabbitMQ message broker identity verification.

news.title: Authentication and authorization options for Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ
news.summary: AWS published a guide covering authentication and authorization options available for Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ, including integration with existing identity infrastructure. The post outlines available methods to help users select the appropriate approach for their specific use case.

news.title: IAM Compliance Requirements and Best Practices
news.summary: An educational guide has been published explaining IAM compliance requirements, covering how identity and access controls must be documented and enforced across users, applications, infrastructure, and non-human identities. The guide addresses relevant regulations and best practices for maintaining compliance in IAM programs.

news.title: Belgium's eID Authentication Opens Citizen Accounts to RCE
news.summary: Belgium's electronic ID (eID) authentication system was found to contain severe vulnerabilities in a key browser extension that fully compromised its trust framework. The flaws enabled remote code execution (RCE), exposing citizen accounts and highlighting broader security risks inherent in browser extension-based authentication mechanisms.

news.title: Gunra Ransomware Gang Exploits Fortinet Flaws, Bypasses MFA
news.summary: The Gunra ransomware gang is exploiting Fortinet vulnerabilities in firewalls and VPN appliances while bypassing MFA protections to target critical infrastructure. The group operates as a ransomware-as-a-service using leaked Conti code alongside unpatched flaws in network perimeter devices.

news.title: 'GhostJacking' Exposes Identity Governance Gaps in AI Agents
news.summary: New research has identified an attack technique called "GhostJacking" that exploits identity governance gaps in AI agents by manipulating security alerts and blocked events to hijack agent behavior. The findings highlight weaknesses in how identity and authorization controls are applied to AI agents operating within enterprise environments.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian national Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges related to hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake's cloud data storage platform. The attacks also resulted in the theft of call and text history records from more than 100 million AT&T customers.

news.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
news.summary: CISA released a postmortem report on a data breach in which a contractor exposed dozens of internal CISA credentials, including AWS GovCloud keys, in a public GitHub repository for nearly six months. The incident highlights credential management failures and gaps in secrets detection and response processes relevant to IAM and PAM practices.

news.title: Scattered Spider Hackers Plead Guilty on Day 1 of Trial
news.summary: Two Scattered Spider members pleaded guilty in the UK to charges related to the August 2024 cyberattack on Transport for London. Scattered Spider is known for sophisticated social engineering and identity-based attacks, including SIM swapping and phishing to bypass MFA and gain unauthorized access to corporate systems.
